name: CPU Scaling Benchmark
desc: Benchmark fixed-work CPU scaling at configurable worker counts, with runtime, CPU utilization, memory observations, speedup, and deterministic result verification.

inputs.desc: Required placeholder T1w input for Brainlife app selection. The benchmark does not read or use this image.

outputs.desc: CPU scaling report with downloadable JSON and CSV

workers.desc: Comma-separated worker process counts. Include 1 for baseline. Max 64; values above the resource CPU allocation test oversubscription, not larger instances.

tasks.desc: Fixed number of independent work items per trial. Must be at least the largest worker count.

iterations.desc: PBKDF2 SHA-256 iterations per work item. Increase to reduce process-startup overhead relative to computation.

repeats.desc: Trials per worker count. Order is shuffled reproducibly each round.

memory_mb_per_worker.desc: MiB allocated and page-touched per worker. Initialization is included in wall time. Not a memory-bandwidth test.

seed.desc: Deterministic workload and trial-order seed; use the same seed across comparisons.
